name: Itomine Yukino
source:
Inclination: Exposure play
Interest: Reading
Likes: Quite places
Dislikes: Excess flesh

A 3rd year student who is the very picture of a beautiful Japanese style woman.
She is the president of the archery club and her archery skill level is nationwide, she also enjoys tea ceremonies and flower arrangements.
While she is a gentle person if someone greatly upsets her she will unthinkingly curse them out.

Unusual Ability: Reverse Mirror Shot
The ability to repel anything directed at her, the object is randomly reflected to someone else. She can even reflect hypnosis but that too is randomly reflected.
